title: Aureline M5 rollback stop
description: Canonical per-domain rollback-stop record minted by the ring-progression and rollback-stop implement lane over the frozen M5 launch-control matrix. Names the rollback-stop condition a launch-bearing lane records — a crash / data-loss / trust defect, a repeated protected-metric regression, or a stale readiness packet — and binds the resolved transition identity, the active stop-condition ledger, the rollback-stop target reference, the protected-metric regression state, the packet-freshness state, the crash / data-loss / trust reference, and the last ring-transition revision, so ring progression cannot advance on a claimed lane while a rollback-stop condition is active, a protected-metric regression is flagged rather than masquerading as covered, and the stop posture stays visible before any ring widens. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's stop conditions by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
